segments.ja357:1.1: Vandāmi taṃ kuñjara saṭṭhihāyanaṃ, āraññakaṃ yūthapatiṃ yasassiṃ;
segments.ja357:1.3: Pakkhehi taṃ pañjalikaṃ karomi, mā me vadhī puttake dubbalāya.
segments.ja357:2.1: Vandāmi taṃ kuñjara ekacāriṃ, āraññakaṃ pabbatasānugocaraṃ;
segments.ja357:2.3: Pakkhehi taṃ pañjalikaṃ karomi, mā me vadhī puttake dubbalāya;
segments.ja357:3.1: Vamissāmi te laṭukike puttakāni, kiṃ me tuvaṃ kāhasi dubbalāsi;
segments.ja357:3.3: Sataṃ sahassānipi tādisīnaṃ, vāmena pādena papothayeyyaṃ.
segments.ja357:4.1: Na heva sabbattha balena kiccaṃ, balañhi bālassa vadhāya hoti;
segments.ja357:4.3: Karissāmi te nāgarājā anatthaṃ, yo me vadhī puttake dubbalāya.
segments.ja357:5.3: Ete nāgaṃ aghātesuṃ, passa verassa verinaṃ;
segments.ja357:5.5: Tasmā hi veraṃ na kayirātha, appiyenapi kenacīti.
